verdict: PASSED with 1 NIT, non-gating. The revision 类型 -> 种类 resolves the round-1 MAJOR (same-rail collision with the Kind sort option) and reads as genuinely native copy: a two-character nominal heading in the same paradigm as its six siblings, 4 cells against a ~12-cell hint, no other control in the rail or the sort menu showing the string, no placeholder/markup/invisible characters, and every hash binding recomputed intact. It also stays out of the three neighbouring words already spent in the same rail (类别 = ui.library.filter.categories, 分类 = ui.hub.taxonomy.heading, 类型 = ui.library.sort.kind). No BLOCKER, no MAJOR, no MINOR.

findings.problem: A record-keeping gap, not a wording defect. 种类 is the ONLY occurrence of this word in the whole zh-CN corpus, and it is the only zh-CN rendering of English 'Type' other than 类型: seven keys in other catalogues render Kind or Type as 类型 (ui.agents.teams.col.type, ui.canvas.variable_form_dialog.type, ui.canvas.files.kind, ui.library.sort.kind, ui.notifications.filter.kind, ui.chat.pickers.info_model.kind, ui.agentMessages.settings.allowlist.kind). The zh-CN style guide has no Locale-calls entry for it, and the glossary has no kind/type row, so a later wave asked to keep 'Type' consistent has nothing on file that marks this one rail header as a deliberate exception rather than drift to be 'fixed' back to 类型.
findings.recommendation: Keep 种类 as written. Add one line under '## Locale calls (zh-CN)' in ~/local-operator/i18n/style-guides/zh-CN.md, e.g. 'tag group Type -> 种类 (Library tag rail; 类型 stays the Kind sort option)', which is the mechanism the glossary itself nominates for per-locale calls ('The per-locale style guides … record only the calls it delegates to them', and footnote 1 records the same mechanism for wake).

prior_findings_disposition.why: F1 asked that the tag-group heading stop sharing one string with the Kind sort option. 类型 -> 种类 removes the shared string: ui.library.sort.kind stays 类型 while the rail header is 种类, and 种类 appears nowhere else in the corpus. The recommendation F1 gave ('种类 — distinct from the corpus's 类型 for Kind') is the value now on disk, so the requested fix is met on the head under audit.
prior_findings_disposition.reasoning_note: F1's supporting claim that 类型 is 'the corpus's settled rendering of the term Kind', and that using it for Type 'breaks the glossary binding', is not supported by the policy files: i18n/glossary.md contains no 类型 or 种类 string at all and no kind/type row (its only 'type' hit is 'event types' in the machine-token line), and the corpus itself renders English 'Type' as 类型 in ui.agents.teams.col.type and ui.canvas.variable_form_dialog.type. The same-rail collision that F1 points at is real and independent of any glossary binding, and it is what this audit verifies: ui.library.sort.kind renders from library-model.ts:84 in the sort menu of the Library view, and the tag headings render from library-filter-rail.tsx:104 as the rail's h3 headings in that same view, so 类型 as a sort option and 类型 as a tag-group header could appear together. Agreeing with the outcome, not with that premise.

concern_verdicts.a_accuracy: pass — Type -> 种类 keeps the meaning: the group holds tags whose values name the asset's type/kind. The current sidecar note calls it a 'LEGACY tag group id kept by the UI's ordering list; current core ids are format/status, so this is rare' and tells the translator to 'Keep it distinct from the sort option Kind' — both instructions are satisfied. No omission, addition, negation, polarity or unsafe-wording risk: the string is a bare heading, carries no permission, destructive or error sense, and no placeholder.
concern_verdicts.b_terminology_consistency: pass with N1 — 种类 is distinct from every word this view already spends on the same ideas: 类型 (ui.library.sort.kind, the Kind sort option, and ui.canvas.files.kind), 类别 (ui.library.filter.categories, in this same rail), 分类 (ui.hub.taxonomy.heading, ui.agents.settings.general.categories) and the sibling heading 自定义 (ui.library.tag_category.custom). The rail's seven headings now read as one paradigm: 格式 / 状态 / 来源 / 项目 / 主题 / 自定义 / 种类. The only cost is that English 'Type' now has two zh-CN renderings corpus-wide (类型 in two unrelated catalogues, 种类 here) — recorded as N1, and a defensible cost because the two are never co-visible.
concern_verdicts.c_collision_matrix: pass — measured against every value in ui.library: 种类 has no twin (the only same-string pairs in the namespace are tag_category.source = filter.source = 来源 and tag_category.status = filter.status = 状态, both pre-existing and both passing round 1). Those two are not evidence that the 类型 clash was harmless: there the English itself repeats one word in two sections (Source filter section vs Source tag group), so the duplicate faithfully mirrors the source, whereas EN 'Type' and 'Kind' are two different words that zh-CN had collapsed into one string — a merge created by the translation, which is what the revision undoes.
concern_verdicts.d_idiom_register: pass — 种类 is ordinary modern Chinese for a class of things (文件种类, 商品种类), a two-character nominal head, where the guide asks for terse labels ('Terse: four-to-eight character lines where possible'), no sentence-final 。 on short labels, no particles — none present. Nothing in it reads as a calque of 'Type'; the natural pair alternatives 类型 and 类别 are unavailable for the reasons above, and the more specific 文件类型/文档类型 would misdescribe the non-document assets the same rail serves.
concern_verdicts.e_rail_parallelism: pass — the value renders inside `<h3 className='px-2 text-meta font-medium tracking-wide text-ink-dim'>` above that category's tag rows (library-filter-rail.tsx Section/TagCategoryLabel); a two-character heading sits level with 格式/状态/来源/项目/主题 and two cells narrower than 自定义 (6 cells). No truncation class applies to the heading, and 4 cells is far inside the 'about 12 characters' narrow-rail hint.
concern_verdicts.f_fit_width: pass — 4 cells (U+79CD U+7C7B, both East Asian Wide) against the ~12-cell hint; the widest sibling is 自定义 at 6 cells.
concern_verdicts.g_invisible_bidi: pass — a full-file scan of zh-CN/ui.library.json found no Cf/Cc/Co/Cn character, no U+200B, U+2060, U+FEFF or U+00A0. 种类 is plain BMP CJK with no variation selector or ZWJ, so no combining-width or segmentation hazard; RTL rules do not apply to this locale.
